removed.statement: No ordinary CFC regime was identified in the current Law on Corporate Income Tax. The law's CFC-adjacent mechanism is a qualified domestic minimum top-up tax under the Income Inclusion Rule, which is a Pillar Two minimum-tax rule and is not recorded as attribution of a foreign subsidiary's undistributed income to a Vietnamese shareholder.
removed.quote: Where an enterprise is required to pay qualified domestic minimum top-up tax under the Income Inclusion Rule (IIR) in accordance with the law, the additional corporate income tax payable shall be deducted from corporate income tax payable in Viet Nam as prescribed by this Law.

removed.subject: all
removed.statement: No ordinary CFC rule in the current corporate-income-tax law attributes a foreign subsidiary's undistributed income to a Vietnamese company or individual shareholder. The law's stated Income Inclusion Rule item is a qualified domestic minimum top-up-tax mechanism, not an ordinary CFC regime.
removed.quote: Where an enterprise is required to pay qualified domestic minimum top-up tax under the Income Inclusion Rule (IIR) in accordance with the law, the additional corporate income tax payable shall be deducted from corporate income tax payable in Viet Nam as prescribed by this Law.

removed.subject: company
removed.statement: No general anti-avoidance rule and no domestic limit on treaty benefits that would deny a Vietnamese company's dividend exemption (art. 4(7)) or foreign tax credit (art. 3(4)) was identified in the Law on Corporate Income Tax, whose scope covers taxpayers, taxable and exempt income, tax bases, calculation methods and incentives only, nor in the consolidated tax-administration Circulars registered (vn.btc.treaty-procedure, vn.btc.tax-administration.14-vbhn-2026). The related-party rule reported on the Government portal (vn.gov.related-party-tax-avoidance, Decree 255/2026/ND-CP) re-determines tax where related-party prices or terms are not at arm's length; it adjusts profits, not the treatment of a dividend. Treaty principal purposes tests are recorded as pair parameters (<pair>.anti_abuse.ppt_applies). The Law on Tax Administration 108/2025/QH15 and Decree 255/2026/ND-CP are not registered; revisit this record when they are.
removed.quote: This Law provides for taxpayers, taxable income, tax-exempt income, tax bases, tax calculation methods, and corporate income tax incentives.

removed.subject: company
removed.statement: No additional corporate-income-tax withholding applies to a dividend paid by a Vietnamese enterprise to a foreign corporate investor where the underlying profit has borne Vietnamese corporate income tax: Article 4(7) exempts distributed profits from capital contribution or share purchases in domestic enterprises after corporate income tax has been paid. This entry is limited to that statutory condition and does not cover a payment that is not a distributed profit or a source-specific tax outside the Law on Corporate Income Tax.
removed.quote: Distributed profits from capital contribution, purchase of shares, joint ventures, and partnership with domestic enterprises, after corporate income tax has been paid in accordance with this Law, including cases where the capital-receiving party, share-issuing party, joint venture, or associate party enjoyr corporate income tax incentives.
